close_reason: Renamed FaultyBackend::check() to take_fault() — self-documents fire-once semantics
description: common/mod.rs FaultyBackend (lines 1624-1626): the private method is named 'check' but it removes the failure flag on first call — it fires once and resets. A reader seeing 'if self.check(O::TYPE_NAME, "create")' must look at the body to discover that 'check' is destructive. This is the opposite of what 'check' conventionally means (non-destructive read). Suggested rename: 'take_fault' or 'consume_fault', matching the remove-on-first-match semantics, so call sites read 'if self.take_fault(...)' which makes the fire-once behavior self-documenting.
title: FaultyBackend::check name obscures fire-once semantics
